newsitem.title: ITALY: Port conditions update - Italy/Pakistan - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Italy/Pakistan - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
ITALY, Sept 30 - Genoa - Two bulk carriers and one general cargo vessel waiting for berths. Average berthing delay half to one day.

PAKISTAN, Sept 30 - Karachi - Four vessels waiting off port. One fertiliser vessel waiting five days, two sugar vessels waiting up to three days and one tanker waiting three days. Five vessels laid up off port for their own reasons.
